technical-summary: Added a fail-closed HI29-HI31 routing-transform build contract. GGML_HIP_ROUTING_TRANSFORM now requires both the tuning dispatch and GGML_HIP_AUTOTUNE_RECORD, preventing partial transform enablement before transform recording, ABI, replay, and runtime dispatcher integration exist. Added source-level regression coverage.
user-summary-candidate: Prevented routing transforms from being enabled in partial builds that cannot record and dispatch them end-to-end; added focused regression coverage.
